$comment: Every MCP client this repo can render a config for. Data, not code: adding a client
is one entry here, never a branch in tools/mcp_sync.py.
The servers are transport-neutral by construction, and that is what makes this table
small. All four stacks resolve their own root from __file__ (GDM_HOME / UNIM_HOME /
RBX_HOME / THREE_RAG_HOME), and cwd is only one candidate when resolving a project
path - so no server NEEDS `cwd`. The only thing a client must get right is PYTHONPATH
(so `python -m gdmaster.mcp...` resolves) plus an absolute interpreter path. Cursor,
for example, has no `cwd` field at all and works anyway.
root      : key path from the file root to the server map.
shape     : how one server entry is spelled. `argv` = {type,command,args,env},
(opencode puts the executable and its arguments in ONE array).
path_style: `workspace` keeps ${workspaceFolder} so the file is portable and can be
committed; `absolute` bakes this machine's paths in and must stay local.
commit    : whether the rendered file belongs in git.
Schemas drift between client versions. Each entry links its docs; `--print-client`
always dumps the block for a client that is not listed here.
